metadata.name: GitLab Orbit MCP Server
metadata.description: MCP access to GitLab Orbit (formerly GitLab Knowledge Graph), the software lifecycle context graph that indexes a top-level GitLab.com group's SDLC entities (projects, work items, merge requests, pipelines, notes, labels, vulnerabilities) and default-branch source code into one property graph. Exposes graph discovery and query tools so an agent can answer questions about code structure, blast radius and cross-project relationships. Beta, and gated by the knowledge_graph feature flag on the top-level group.
